# Test mermaid diagram generation

# Generate mermaid from file
sc mermaid chart.json
stdout 'stateDiagram-v2'
stdout 'direction TB'
stdout 'Red --> Green : TIMER_EXPIRED'

# Test direction flag
sc mermaid -dir LR chart.json
stdout 'direction LR'

# Pipeline: read from stdin
stdin-sc chart.json mermaid
stdout 'stateDiagram-v2'
stdout 'Red --> Green'

-- chart.json --
{
  "root_state": {
    "label": "__root__",
    "type": 2,
    "children": [
      {"label": "Red", "type": 1, "is_initial": true},
      {"label": "Green", "type": 1},
      {"label": "Yellow", "type": 1}
    ]
  },
  "transitions": [
    {"from": ["Red"], "to": ["Green"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"from": ["Green"], "to": ["Yellow"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"from": ["Yellow"], "to": ["Red"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"}
  ]
}
